sentences.text: Task 2. Helen, Mike and John are now discussing which theme to choose for their YouTube clips.
Listen to their discussion and fill in the missing information in the spaces provided in the table.
You now have 30 seconds to study the task.
At the end of the task, you will have one minute to tidy up your answers.
Right, Ms. Stanley says she wants us to choose a theme for the six YouTube clips.
We need to tell her by the end of today and explain the reasons for our choice.
I've got the new list of themes we've come up with and we'll just go through them and vote yes, no or maybe for each one.
Um, Mike, can you just remind me of the themes again so I can write them down?
Sure. So we have Wild animals in Hong Kong, Important places in Hong Kong, Famous people in Hong Kong and Hong Kong comics.
Let’s start with Wild animals then.
I'm putting a tick for myself.
I like this theme a lot.
I think most people are interested interested in animals, you know, because they can be cute or scary.
Are there cute animals in Hong Kong?
I mean, there are plenty of scary insects and snakes here but cute animals?
Really? Well, they're deer in Hong Kong.
They’re quite cute.
Well, okay I suppose.
What’s the matter Mike?
Don’t you like this theme?
No. I really want to do this theme.
Animals will be good to film.
They move in different ways.
That makes some very good subjects for this kind of project.
Well, put me down for a yes.
I love animals, but what I think is good about wild animals is that different animals are colorful.
That's true. We want our videos to be colorful.
Okay, so let’s move on to Important places in Hong Kong.
Personally, I’m not sure about this one.
Sorry John, I know you suggested this theme.
Why? What's the problem with it?
I don’t know.
It’s just that I think most students know about these places already.
What do you think Mike?
I’m a no.
Places and buildings don’t move and that makes them dull to look at on video.
video. I think it would be a very dull theme overall.
Like you say Helen, students know about these places already.
Well, we could go beyond what most students know already and find exciting stories about each place.
I think. I mean we could.
um, Let it go John, We've decided it’s too boring.
Okay, let's have a look at the next theme.
Famous people, Yeah.
That's right. I’m also a maybe on this one.
I reckon most famous people would probably be too busy to speak to us.
I think this is a great idea, actually.
It would be good for the school’s image Good for the school’s image?
How does that work Mike?
Well, I don’t know, Well, I think the only people we're going to get to interview are people that students students are not interested in.
Helen’s right. We're not going to get movie stars or pop stars, we're just going to get some boring old writer.
Okay John. Fine.
We all get your point.
Let's look at the last theme and finish up Well, this is another one of my suggestions.
Hong Kong comics.
I hope you guys will say yes for this one.
I love comics.
To be honest, I think that this theme is too common.
I want to do something a bit different.
But the drawings are amazing.
Okay, the artwork is amazing Mike but aren't these comics just for boys?
Not all of them.
I know what you mean though Helen.
I’m not sure about this idea Many of the comics seem to be very similar.
Well, that’s it then.
It looks like Wild animals of Hong Kong is our theme Yeah?
Okay. I guess so.
